class JobApplicationFilterSet(django_filters.FilterSet):
    recruiter_id = django_filters.NumberFilter(field_name='job_posting__recruiter_id')

    class Meta:
        model = JobApplication
        fields = ['recruiter_id', 'stage']

class JobApplicationListView(generics.ListAPIView):
    queryset = JobApplication.objects.all()
    serializer_class = JobApplicationSerializer
    filter_backends = [DjangoFilterBackend]
    filterset_class = JobApplicationFilterSet
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
diagnosis: The view exposes all JobApplication records using a global queryset and enables filtering by recruiter_id. Any authenticated candidate or external recruiter can list other recruiters' job applications, exposing resumes, salaries, and background check data.
